description:
Who We Are 

 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 

 What We Offer 

 Location:
Icheon-Gwango,KOR 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. Local expert of EDX(Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy) Algorithm engineering and support group for Algorithm matters at customer site 
 
 2. Algorithm Support at Customer Site 
 Application support for algorithm-induced challenges, such as measurement error, data reliability, correlation, and matching issues, etc. at customer site 
 Providing the solution on algo issues – Diagnostics(R/C) and troubleshooting 
 Guiding new implemented algo feature and providing training for account Apps 
 Algo & utility bug fixing – Support for worldwide reported bug fixing as a member of algo developer 
 Communicate issues and feedback to PDC Algo group and get inputs for troubleshooting at customer site 
 Demonstrate excellent communication skills to improve customer satisfaction 
 
 3. Algorithm Engineering & Development 
 Working cooperation with algorithm development group in PDC & AMIND 
 Algorithm integration in large systems considering HW and SW aspects 
 Engage in customer facing activities to aid algorithms' proliferation at customer sites 
 Extending tool performance with the clear gap mapping and performance analysis for improving data reliability & measurement success, EoU, TTR, etc. 
 Provide software specifications and production code on time to meet project milestones 
 Close work with the applications, system, physics, software, and qualification groups in order to understand the customers’ requirements and system constraints 
 Participating in communication chain with customer to clear understand VoC and challenges from a technical perspective to develop in the right direction 
 Performing C&F for CIP and preliminary research for new feature in next generation algo development, and beta testing in customer site 
 
 Requirements: 
 Master’s degree and above 
 Strong theoretical foundation and > 3year proven hands-on experience in Physics and Spectrum Data Analysis 
 Thorough understanding of probability, statistics and Signal Processing Algorithm 
 Strong skills in developing in MATLAB and Python 
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a team 
 Fluent English – verbal and text 
 Team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills 
 Travel – capable for initial 1-2 months travel and later willingness to travel up to 15% 
 Advantage:
a. Theoretical and hands-on experience in EDX, Data Analysis and simulation
b. Theoretical and hands-on experience in Machine Learning
c. Understanding of imaging systems and physics
d. Development experience in Java and C/C++
e. Experience in multidisciplinary and matrix organization
f. Experienced with semiconductors organizations 
 
 
 Additional Information 
 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
No 
 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
